_comment: Glossary fixes applied on top of the generated keywords.json (which comes from the community builder bundle). Sourced from the verified rulebook digests in ../rules. Keep this file when re-running tools/extract_cards.js — it is merged at load time by the app.
_corrections: 推动X was labelled 'Knock Back X' in the bundle, which collides with 击退X 'Knockback X'; the rulebook names it Push X (it alone reduces Link). 离子武器 was OCR'd as 'lon Weapon' (capital I read as lowercase L). 多目标X shipped a truncated English value in the bundle, cut off mid-list at "applied at this time;" while the Chinese ran to the end of the rule; the remainder is translated from the Chinese here. Three Command entries were rewritten from rulebook 3.2.1 and 4.15: 指令生成X shipped a stray full stop ("rather than 1.。") and did not say the X REPLACES the default; 指令协调X read "issue 1 Command Token to X Ally Drones", which loses that the Drones must be DIFFERENT and that it works outside the Command Phase; 遥控武器 was OCR’d with "Commandn per turn" and called the phase a "Command Stage".

en.name: Freehand
en.value: Tag: this limb has an open hand and can be designated to support another Part's Action. Enables [Two-Handed] conditional effects, is required by the Throw keyword, and is needed to pick up a Black Box (which then occupies the hand). Parts with the Handheld tag usually gain Freehand in their Discard state.

en.name: Two-Handed
en.value: Conditional: when performing this Action, if another Part with the Freehand tag is designated to support it, the [Two-Handed] effects listed on the card apply.

en.name: Missile Group X
en.value: Each Missile Group contains X Units. They must move together and attack the same target, but Interception and Explosion damage resolve separately for each Unit. Example: an RKG70 model is a group of 3; one successful interception in flight removes 1 Unit, so 2 models arrive and cause 2 Detonations.

en.name: Projectile
en.value: Archetype tag on the card banner: this Unit is a Projectile (launched, then resolves in the Delay Phase). Not a special rule; see Ch. 4.7 and the card's own actions.

en.name: Deployable
en.value: Archetype tag on the card banner: this Unit is a Deployable placed on the ground (mines, walls, beacons). Not a special rule; see Ch. 4.7 and the card's own actions.

en.name: Missile
en.value: Projectile subtype tag on the card banner. Not a special rule; the card's actions carry its behaviour.

en.name: Rocket
en.value: Projectile subtype tag on the card banner. Not a special rule; the card's actions carry its behaviour.

en.name: Cruising
en.value: If there is no target within Range, this Projectile is not destroyed. It flies to any Grid within Range instead and stays on the board.

en.name: Grenade
en.value: Projectile subtype tag on the card banner. Not a special rule; the card's actions carry its behaviour.

en.name: Smart Grenade
en.value: Projectile subtype tag on the card banner. Not a special rule; the card's actions carry its behaviour.

en.name: Smoke Grenade
en.value: Projectile subtype tag on the card banner. On Detonation these place Smoke Screens; see Ch. 4.16 and the card's actions.

en.name: Mine
en.value: Deployable subtype tag on the card banner. Mines typically carry a Trigger action that detonates when a Ground Unit enters their grid.

en.name: Self-propelled Mine
en.value: Deployable subtype tag on the card banner: a mine able to move. See the card's own actions.

en.name: Wall
en.value: Deployable subtype tag on the card banner: a placed barrier. See the card for its height and whether it blocks line of sight.

en.name: Beacon
en.value: Deployable subtype tag on the card banner: a placed marker providing support effects. See the card's own actions.

en.name: Mobile Cover
en.value: Deployable subtype tag on the card banner: deployable cover that can reposition. See the card's own actions.

en.name: Electronic Countermeasures
en.value: Deployable subtype tag on the card banner: electronic-warfare support. See the card's own actions and Ch. 4.11.

en.name: Tether X
en.value: Place a Tether X Token on this unit (the initiating unit) and a Tethered X Token on the target, putting the two units in a Tether state. While it lasts, the tethered unit cannot voluntarily move to a position beyond X grids from the initiating unit. Note the leash binds only that end: the initiating unit may move where it likes, but doing so can break the Tether. Both Tokens are removed when any of three things happens: the initiating unit voluntarily moves beyond X grids from the tethered unit; the initiating unit is Penetrated; or either unit is forcibly moved so that the distance between them ends up greater than X. (Printed in full on the Ols1B "Harpoon" Emergency Recovery System card, PDLH-202, which is also where the English name Tether comes from; the keyword has no entry in the rulebook appendix.)

en.name: Ion Weapon
en.value: When hitting a target with a Fragile Token, may exchange {Lightning} for {Heavy Hit}.

en.name: Push X
en.value: After this action ends, the target is forced to move X grids along the attack direction. If the target is a Mech, its Link is reduced by 1. (Same forced-movement rules as Knockback X: straight line, stops early if blocked by Units or Terrain.)

en.name: Non-humanoid X
en.value: When performing this Action, -X Link Value. The only card carrying it is the PLK400 "Centaur" High-mobility Chassis (ZHLT-301), whose Run is Non-humanoid 1, and its SK variant. (Name and wording both printed in English on the card and in the publisher's Part Data GoF 1.021 EN list; the keyword has no entry in the rulebook appendix.)

en.name: Electronic Attack
en.value: This Action is an Electronic Attack (EA) . When there is an effect that modifies "Electronic Attacks", this Action will be affected by it;If not further described, this Action targets an Enemy Unit, requires an Electronic counter-roll, and takes effect if successful.

en.name: Electronic Support
en.value: This Action is Electronic Support (ES). When there is an effect that modifies "Electronic support", this Action will be affected by it;If not further described, this Action targets Friendly Units and does not require Electronic counter-rolls. It takes effect automatically.

en.name: Volley X
en.value: Fire or deploy up to X Projectiles with this one Action, consuming an equal number of Ammo Tokens. You may repeat the declare-and-place steps until X projectiles have been launched, and Interception is then checked once at the end of the Action rather than per projectile.

en.name: Intercept X
en.value: This Action may be used for Interception, and starts the game with X Interception Tokens face-up on its Card. Interception triggers when an enemy Aerial Unit moves or is launched and either the starting or ending grid of that movement is within this Action's Range. Each attempt consumes 1 token and attacks like a Firing Action, except that the target must be the unit that triggered it, the target need not be in the Forward Arc, and line of sight always exists so neither Terrain nor Unit Protection can be claimed. If the target survives, you must keep attempting Interceptions until it is destroyed or the tokens run out.

en.name: Target Tracer
en.value: When a Drone performs Automatic Actions, it may designate a Unit bearing a Target Tracer Token as the target even if it is not the closest Enemy Unit. When a Drone performs any Attack / Electronic Attack targeting a Unit bearing a Target Tracer Token, it is treated as being in the Offensive Stance.

en.name: Multi-Target X
en.value: This Action can select X targets at the same time. If it does, resolve the Attack as follows: determine the total number of Attack Dice for this Action, applying any effect that increases that number now; split those dice between the targets however you like, then run one separate attack sequence against each target in turn, rolling the dice allotted to it. If a Mech performs this Action it may Focus on each attack sequence separately. If the Attack inflicts a special effect, each attack sequence applies that effect to its own target on its own.

en.name: Barricade
en.value: While another Ally Unit is the target of an Attack, this Unit counts as 3-inch high Terrain, so it can block line of sight or grant Terrain Protection to the unit behind it.

en.name: Hit
en.value: Conditional keyword. When this Attack is resolved, the effect applies if any Damage was not offset by a [Dodge]. A [Defense] icon still counts as a Hit, so an attack can trigger this without causing a Penetration.

en.name: Unstoppable
en.value: Movement Actions with this Keyword can still be performed while the unit is Immobilized.

en.name: Moving in Straight Line
en.value: Conditional keyword. The effect applies if the entire Movement Path this Action makes runs in a single direction, wholly horizontal or wholly vertical across the board. (The traditional form 直線移動 also appears in the card data; it is the same keyword.)

en.name: Command Generation X
en.value: At the start of the Command Phase this Mech generates X Command Tokens instead of the default 1, placed face-up on its Torso Part Card. X REPLACES the 1 rather than adding to it (3.2.1). Six Torso cards print it: 4 on the P7 Warrior, P7-A3 Centurion and P22 Hunter, 2 on the P28 Dragoon, P24 Chariot and TM31Q Wild Cat.

en.name: Command Coordination X
en.value: After performing this Action, this Mech may issue up to X Command Tokens it held back, one each to X DIFFERENT Ally Drones, laid face-down (4.15.3). Each Drone that takes one immediately performs 1 Movement Action or 1 Command Action. It works outside the Command Phase, so a Drone that already acted this round may take one: the token it was given then was removed when that phase ended.

en.name: RWS
en.value: Remote Weapon Station. During the Command Phase an Ally may send a Command to this Mech to perform this Action, which is the one case where a MECH receives a Command Token rather than a Drone. This Part can only receive one Command per round.
